source_conversation.content: My iPhone 15 screen won't turn sideways when I tilt it. I want it to rotate so I can watch videos. What do I do?

candidates.decision_basis: The user states an iPhone 15, which has no Home button, so the iPhone without a Home button section applies. The Android ref is inapplicable.
candidates.target:
Here is how to let your iPhone screen rotate again.
1. Swipe down from the top-right corner of your screen to open Control Center.
2. Tap the **Portrait Orientation Lock** button and confirm it is off.
3. Close Control Center.
4. Turn the iPhone sideways.
Some apps don't support rotation, so your screen might not rotate even if Portrait Orientation Lock isn't turned on. If you don't see the **Portrait Orientation Lock** button, learn how to access more controls in Control Center.
candidates.author_note: Cover every step from the iPhone ref, keep the note that some apps do not rotate, and keep the condition about the missing button. No Android steps. No source gap for this user's model.
